## Install

1. Download `share-it.apk` (below) on your Android phone. You need Android 11 or later.
2. Open the file. Android asks you to allow installs from your browser or Files app.
3. Open **share-it** and tap **Start sharing**. Then follow the [Quick start](https://github.com/amjadaziz817/share-it#quick-start).

This APK is a debug build. If you installed share-it from another source, uninstall it first.
The connection uses plain HTTP. Use share-it only on Wi-Fi networks that you trust.
